title.en: An Act Declaring October 2 of Every Year An official Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Majayjay, Province of Laguna and in All its Barangays, to Be Known as the Majayjay Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring October 2 of Every Year An official Nonworking Holiday in the Municipality of Majayjay, Province of Laguna and in All its Barangays, to Be Known as the Majayjay Day

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9701_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: October 2 of every year is hereby declared an official nonworking holiday in the Municipality of Majayjay, Province of Laguna and in all the barangays therein to commemorate the foundation of the municipality, to be known as the "Majayjay Day".
This Act take effect upon its approval.
